scientific_integrity: The universal boundary-layer limit and entropy formula have a written analytic proof; exact algebra and finite-volume tests are supplemental. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Globally inward-oriented periodic cusp-cusp potentials with a uniform drift margin, constant orientation flip rate, fixed positive propulsion speed, and full-state Fokker--Planck entropy production. Smooth extrema, thresholds, and higher-dimensional extensions are unproved.
title: Universal zero-noise entropy for globally confining cusp ratchets
